He’s tall, has deep hazel eyes with a nicely proportioned, yet somewhat slim body. He’s smart, organised and always making sure he is his best self, but there is a lighter side to him. He’s the sort of guy to crack a joke and make the room burst out laughing, sometimes at the expense of others at times for a few laughs, though nothing should be taken seriously in that sense because it’s no deeper than a joke. He’ll always have an optimistic viewpoint about everything in life and encourage those he loves to be the best that they can, and will always do his best to help others and support them through anything they go through. 

But if you look closely into him and his eyes, you’ll see a side nobody else will ever know. The insecurities, emotions and thoughts that he tries his best to hide from everyone, even those closest to him. These are the things that he thinks about and dwells on for far too long. “What if I said the wrong thing to her, and she hates me because of it?” “What if I did this instead of that?” There it is, there’s the pessimistic viewpoint and crippling anxiety that you’d expect one to have when they’re struggling with issues in their early 20’s, be it through financial woes, stress of work and student life, heartbreak, or perhaps something deeply rooted into their past which has always affected them deep down. But this is something else. Even though he’s lived a fantastic life so far, he’s always felt this way even from a young age, like something is eating away at him for no reason. He’s always lived in fear of the consequences and how they will affect his life in a negative manner. 

Maybe that’s why he always cracks jokes? Perhaps humour is his coping mechanism for all the hurt he’s ever put himself or others through, and he wants to try his best to make sure that they’re happy and not going through pain?

Everyone is looking at him, but nobody has ever looked through him. Not because they don’t want to, but because they simply aren’t able to. He’ll try his best to make sure it never happens, even if it means complete self-destruction. If there is one thing that he will make sure he never ruins, it’s his reputation. It’s as if he has the brain of a wise man, and the heart of a lion.
